problem_statement: RIOT's ztimer subsystem lacks power management awareness. Timer peripherals remain powered on permanently, even when no timers are active. This PR adds ztimer_acquire() and ztimer_release() functions that implement reference-counted on-demand power management for ztimer clock sources. When enabled, ztimer peripherals are only started when at least one timer is actively using them, and stopped when the last user releases the clock. The ztimer_ondemand module also adds start() and stop() ops to periph_timer, periph_rtt, and periph_rtc backends.
build_command: make -C tests/unittests BOARD=native clean all UNIT_TESTS=tests-ztimer
